02 / PC UNIT MASTERY

Investigate the Alaris 8015 PC Unit

Bench intake: a PC Unit and attached modules arrive with intermittent recognition, difficult module release, or loss of backup power. Training only; no patient connected.

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

Distinguish central control, power, electrical communication and mechanical attachment faults using reported symptoms and evidence.

Your assignment

  1. Choose one of the seven inspection topics below the main image, or select a visible front-panel hotspot.
  2. Inspect the component-specific view and read its function and bench relevance. Reference photographs with unconfirmed part identity are flagged in this private draft.
  3. Compare left female and right male IUI connectors, and distinguish electrical faults from mechanical release faults.
  4. Complete eleven scenario-based competency questions.
  5. Review missed questions until you achieve 100% mastery.

Upon completion, you should be able to:

  • Differentiate central display and input faults.
  • Distinguish AC power from backup battery symptoms.
  • Recognize evidence of IUI contact contamination.
  • Recognize mechanical module-release binding.
  • Distinguish wireless network failure from module recognition faults.
  • Select appropriate fault isolation and verification steps.
